brief.text:
First UI pass for Kris, Mookie and Buddy, before the FigCraft layout arrives.

Look: doc 11 (Daydream theme, Pastel option via the Theme tweak on boards 1 and 3).
Layout: doc 11 §11.4 — project bar, environment tabs instead of a ribbon, a short project-specific toolbox, context panel, maker-worded timeline, status bar with the material meter.
Icons: drawn to the rules in doc 18 (64-unit grid, ink outline, pastel fill, one accent at most).

Comment anywhere: what feels right, what doesn't.
